name: prompt-lift
description: Enhance your prompts using project instructions and skills

models.title: Model Chain
models.description: Comma-separated models to try in order: an alias (fable, sonnet, haiku), a full model id, or session for the session's model; on Bedrock/Vertex pin full ids for prices

effortModels.title: Effort Models
effortModels.description: Models that accept the effort parameter; they are sent effort: low

timeoutMsFirst.title: First Attempt Timeout (ms)
timeoutMsFirst.description: Timeout for the first model attempt

minWords.title: Minimum Words
minWords.description: Minimum word count to trigger enhancement

maxDraftChars.title: Max Draft Characters
maxDraftChars.description: Maximum characters in the draft prompt

keptShareFloor.title: Kept Share Floor
keptShareFloor.description: Minimum fraction of original words to keep

relevantSkills.title: Relevant Skills
relevantSkills.description: Number of relevant skills to include

instructionFileMaxChars.title: Instruction File Max Characters
instructionFileMaxChars.description: Maximum characters to read from instruction files

enhanceAction.title: Enhance Action
enhanceAction.description: Engine keybinding action whose chord presses Enhance from the prompt (empty disables)

filePrefix.title: File Prefix Style
filePrefix.description: How to prefix file paths in prompts

skillPlacement.title: Skill Placement
skillPlacement.description: How to include skills in prompts

includeConversation.title: Include Conversation
includeConversation.description: Include recent conversation history in prompts

conversationMessages.title: Conversation Messages
conversationMessages.description: Number of recent messages to include

skillPrefixAllow.title: Skill Prefix Allow
skillPrefixAllow.description: Comma-separated list of allowed skill prefixes (empty for none)

instructionExclude.title: Instruction Exclude
instructionExclude.description: Comma-separated list of instruction files to exclude (globs; also a named subproject's CLAUDE.md)

skillExclude.title: Skill Exclude
skillExclude.description: Comma-separated skill name patterns left out of the listing sent to the model (* and ? wildcards, e.g. sparc:*,gws-*); empty sends every skill Claude lists

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: JSON string: map of model id fragment to per-1M-token prices {"<key>": {"input","output","cacheWrite","cacheRead"}} merged over the built-in table; invalid JSON is ignored with a log line

sessionCapUsd.title: Session Spend Cap (USD)
sessionCapUsd.description: Refuse a press once this session's priced presses reach these dollars (0 = no cap); /prompt-lift cap <usd|off> overrides it for the session

dayCapUsd.title: Day Spend Cap (USD)
dayCapUsd.description: Refuse a press once today's priced presses, across sessions, reach these dollars (0 = no cap)

extraRules.title: Extra rules
extraRules.description: Project preferences appended to the rewrite rules as rule 11 (max 1,000 characters; tag-like markup is neutralised)
